purpose: Empirical receipt: SPECTRAL (fiber-blind, prior verb) vs SPECTRAL_GAUGE (fiber-aware, NEW verb shipped 2026-06-28 at gigi commit e37ae9e) on two buckyball SU(2) bundles.
discipline: Receipts before letters (Bee, 2026-06-28). Technical work first, letter after.

schema_used.note: Composite keys put vertex_a/vertex_b in base_fields as SPECTRAL_GAUGE expects (src/spectral.rs:1146-1150). REST POST /v1/bundles handler (src/bin/gigi_stream.rs:1922-1944) maps fields named in 'keys' to base_fields; the prior schema with keys=[edge_id] only put edge_id in base_fields and caused SPECTRAL_GAUGE to error 'missing edge endpoint fields vertex_a/vertex_b'.

spectral_gauge_beta_2_5.query: SPECTRAL_GAUGE halcyon_ym_buckyball_beta_2_5_links ON FIBER (q0, q1, q2, q3) GROUP SU(2);

spectral_gauge_beta_1_0.query: SPECTRAL_GAUGE halcyon_ym_buckyball_beta_1_0_links ON FIBER (q0, q1, q2, q3) GROUP SU(2);

SPECTRAL_fiber_blind.notes:
Re-confirms the e4800b4 receipt: agreement to 4 sig figs across 2.25x change in

. Same line-graph Laplacian on the field-index graph; reads vertex_a/vertex_b adjacency but NOT q0..q3 fiber.

SPECTRAL_GAUGE_fiber_aware.notes: NEW VERB (e37ae9e) — fiber-weighted normalized Laplacian L_A = D^(-1/2)(D-W)D^(-1/2), W_ij = Re Tr(U_e)/2 = q0 for SU(2). Gap is the smallest signed eigenvalue. Negative because q0 ∈ [-1, +1] makes the weighted matrix indefinite (signed Laplacian) — honest math per the doc framing 'globally gauge-invariant, locally gauge-covariant'.

headline.evidence:
SPECTRAL agrees to 4 sig figs (0.000033 difference) across 2.25x change in

— fiber-blind as documented. SPECTRAL_GAUGE differs by 0.5573 (ratio 0.815) on the same data — fiber-aware. Difference is 17145x larger than the fiber-blind SPECTRAL noise floor.

math_caveats_to_carry_forward: The 'gap' field is the smallest signed eigenvalue of the normalized signed Laplacian, not a non-negative spectral gap. For SU(2), edge weights = q0 = Re Tr(U)/2 ∈ [-1, +1], so the weighted matrix is indefinite. The verb name 'GAP' should be read as 'smallest non-zero eigenvalue', not 'spectral gap' in the textbook sense. This matches the spec's honest framing ('fiber-weighted spectral gap, not the strict Yang-Mills mass gap').
On the buckyball (V=60, E=90), V^2 = 3600 — well within Phase 1's dense path. Phase 2 (Lanczos sparse) is unnecessary at this scale.
n_records_used = 90 confirms all 90 link records were folded into the Laplacian. Adjacency built from vertex_a/vertex_b base_fields.
